name: jokes
description: A jokebook for other people's jokes. Save a joke credited to the comedian who told it and where it is from (special, album, set, link), tag it, search it, pull a random one, vote locally. Share one joke as a link or a whole comedian as a pack: plain JSON someone else imports. Joke ids are a content hash of text + comedian, so two books merge without duplicates. One local SQLite file, stdlib only, no accounts or keys.

endpoints.GET /info: Null call — what this module is, with book stats
endpoints.GET /health: Liveness — touches only the local file
endpoints.GET /search: Search text, comedian, source, tags (q, comedian, tag, sort=new|top|old|random, limit, offset)
endpoints.GET /comedians: Every comedian in the book, with counts
endpoints.GET /share: One joke as a link, plain text and a one-joke pack (id)
endpoints.GET /export: A pack of ids, a comedian, a tag, or everything (ids, comedian, tag, name)
endpoints.POST /add: Save a joke {text, comedian, source, year, tags, by}
endpoints.POST /vote: +1/-1 a joke {id, delta}; votes stay local
endpoints.POST /import_pack: Merge a pack {pack} — same text+comedian = same id = no duplicate
endpoints.POST /remove: Delete a joke {id} — loopback callers only
